g.font-family: SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace
g.text: Break the checkout redesign into tasks
Status Opt+s focus the status window
Quit Ctrl+Opt+x exit menu: save and exit, detach, update tandem, discard
Layout Ctrl+Opt+z resize mode: arrows resize the focused pane, = resets, Enter exits
Status Tab switch between the Status and Queries tabs
Opt+g go to the highlighted or asking agent's pane
Queries Enter answer the selected open question
1-9 fill the answer with a numbered option
Opt+w mark the selected question withdrawn
Esc clear the draft and return to the list
Model Opt+f focus the model filter
click a status-bar hint = press its key
click a column title to pick one of its agents from a menu
right-click a pane = context menu (focus, restart, close, new agent, …)
click a pane to focus it; drag a border to resize; scroll wheel scrolls
Resize Ctrl+Opt+z then arrows (←→ 5 columns, ↑↓ 2 rows) on the focused pane; = resets; Enter exits
Custom set TANDEM_KEYS="help=Ctrl+Opt+h,quit=Ctrl+Opt+q" (each needs at least one modifier)
Detach your agents keep running; run `tandem` again to re-attach
Opt+h Help Ctrl+Opt+n New agent Opt+Up Prev Opt+Down Next Opt+s Status Opt+q Queries Opt+1 Planners Opt+2 Implementers Ctrl+Opt+w Close Ctrl
